rooms.name: Clay Gate
rooms.description: Wet fingerprints from three generations remain in the half-fired gateposts.

rooms.name: Test Tile Rack
rooms.description: Tiny fired tiles record what the kiln looked like at every possible heat, from rose to bottle green.

rooms.name: Slip Vat
rooms.description: Fine clay turns the water opaque. A model of a dam seat lies at the bottom under a film of slip.

rooms.name: Glaze Mill
rooms.description: The millstone grinds sea glass until it can be brushed onto pressure gauges.

rooms.name: Kiln Mouth
rooms.description: The fire is cold. An iron cradle in the ashes is shaped for the return valve at the listening works.

rooms.name: Coal Eye
rooms.description: A mica window once let a stoker watch the fire without losing their lashes.

rooms.name: Pipe Mould
rooms.description: Two ceramic half-pipes interlock. The bevel on the return half insists that water can run the other way.

rooms.name: Drying Strings
rooms.description: Clay whistles hang on strings. The cracked whistles carry a truer warning note than the whole ones.

rooms.name: Stoker's Bunk
rooms.description: A stoker could judge the heat with one bare foot against the wall. There is a heel-shaped patch of polished brick.

rooms.name: Saggar Stack
rooms.description: Protective firing boxes are stacked upside down. Their unglazed feet have left rings like tide marks.

rooms.name: Ember Court
rooms.description: Nell blows over a red tile and listens to it tick. She builds pressure sleeves and will tell anyone where they go.

encounters.cue: Nell the kiln worker listens to the glaze cooling. She wants one of her sleeves to outlive its maker.
encounters.result: Nell fitted a ceramic sleeve to the listening works return valve. Her maker mark is a bird with one wing. It will hold a split flow if someone sets the trim.

rooms.name: Brick Library
rooms.description: A plan of the district runs along the edges of stacked bricks. Missing bricks have left whole streets blank.

rooms.name: Flue Bend
rooms.description: The chimney turns a right angle here to avoid an older bell cable. The cable is still warm.

rooms.name: Shard Walk
rooms.description: Blue and green shards have been set into the path with their edges down. Boot soles make them sing.

rooms.name: Lime Store
rooms.description: Quicklime is kept on shelves above the highest historic waterline. A new damp patch has reached the bottom shelf.

rooms.name: Mason's Bowl
rooms.description: A bowl of soft mortar preserves a message written with the wrong end of a spoon: give the wall somewhere to move.

rooms.name: Annealing Shelf
rooms.description: A warm shelf holds a ceramic egg. If the egg cracks, the big pressure sleeve has cooled too fast.

rooms.name: Pipe Wagon
rooms.description: A narrow wagon carried finished sleeves to the salt railway. Its brake is tied with ferry rope.

rooms.name: Vent Lantern
rooms.description: Flame flickers sideways through a flue to the listening works. Someone whistles back on the other side.

rooms.name: Cinder Sieve
rooms.description: The last heap has been picked clean of nails. A handful of small brass buttons is all that remains.

links.hint: Brine covers the lift floor until the trial weir draws the lake down.
